text.tspan: Annual economic damages from all natural disasters as a share of GDP
Damages are expressed as a share of gross domestic product (GDP). Disasters include events such as earthquakes,
volcanoes, droughts, wildfires, storms, and floods.
Data source: EM-DAT, CRED / UCLouvain (2026); National statistical organizations and central banks, OECD national accounts, and World
Note: Based on recorded events; coverage is more limited before the year 2000. Longer historical trends may partly reflect reporting
